required_clauses.title: Independent Contractor Services
required_clauses.description: Defines deliverables, scope of work, and the contractor’s responsibilities to provide services independent of the hiring party’s control.

required_clauses.title: Confidentiality and Use Restrictions
required_clauses.description: Protects non-public information provided to the contractor and limits use to performing the services.

required_clauses.title: Ownership and License for Work Product
required_clauses.description: Allocates rights in deliverables and any work product, including assignment/licensing of IP generated during the engagement.

required_clauses.title: Fees and Invoicing
required_clauses.description: Specifies the fee structure, invoicing requirements, payment timing, and any dispute/withholding procedures.

required_clauses.title: Termination for Convenience and Cause
required_clauses.description: Provides grounds for termination and notice/cure periods, including obligations that survive termination.

optional_clauses.title: Non-Solicitation
optional_clauses.description: May restrict solicitation of the hiring party’s personnel where enforceable.
